reference.citation: Welch PD (1967). The use of FFT for the estimation of power spectra. IEEE Trans Audio Electroacoust 15(2):70-73. Reference impl: scipy.signal.coherence (Virtanen et al. 2020). Data: BIDMC PPG and Respiration Dataset (Pimentel et al. 2017), PhysioNet.
reference.description: re-computes the coherence spectrum with scipy.signal.coherence (matched symmetric-Hann + no detrend) and compares to coherence's; reports the full-spectrum max |diff| (< 1e-9, machine precision), the cardiac-band (0.5-5 Hz) peak coherence (0.898) + its frequency (1.465 Hz ~ 88 bpm), the band mean (0.439), and the 95% confidence limit
